anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 (connected between the Display_Power_Switch / boost-input node and GND) is drawn with value 0.1 µF / 16 V.
anomalies.expected: The specification's EPD-driver mapping table states the schematic C1 belongs to the set 'C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V' (the PDI 'C2 default' bulk/decoupling capacitor). The other five members of that set (C5, C7, C8, C9, C10) are indeed drawn as 1 µF/25 V on this sheet, so C1 is the lone deviation.

evidence.quote: EPD_Driver.kicad_sch (page 3/4): 'C1 0.1uF/16V' (capacitor from the L1/Display_Power_Switch node to GND)
C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default

anomalies.impact: The boost-converter input bulk/decoupling capacitor is 10× smaller than intended (0.1 µF instead of 1 µF). During e-paper refresh the boost stage draws large pulsed currents; the undersized cap raises input ripple and can cause the 3.3 V display rail to dip, degrading or stalling display refresh. The voltage rating is also reduced (16 V vs 25 V), though still above the 3.3 V node, so the capacitance error is the dominant concern.

parsed.summary: The build deviates from the reference at C1 on the EPD_Driver sheet: it is drawn as 0.1 µF/16 V whereas the specification (and the matching C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 on the same sheet) requires 1 µF/25 V, indicating a wrong-value/wrong-rating component in the e-paper boost input decoupling.
